text:
mika: quick note from today's panel review: a couple of fresh asks — (1) make p95 meaning explicit for PMs, (2) fix scrubber hit area on Macbooks, (3) consider a confidence ribbon around p95 so users see variance.

raj: agree on confidence ribbon. sketch: semi-transparent band around the percentile line showing 10th-90th spread. low visual weight so it doesn't compete with heatmap.

ella: scrubber hit target: bump to 28px invisible target, keep visible thumb slim. also add a focus ring and an aria-describedby explaining keyboard shortcuts.

mika: presets naming proposal: Throughput / Balanced / Precision (instead of Low/Med/High). microcopy: "Throughput — favors cost and throughput; Precision — preserves tail accuracy."

raj: sampling label confusion still popping up. recommend `Sampling: 0.1% (≈1 in 1000 requests)` and include sample count in tooltip `sampled ≈ 820`.

ella: p95 copy: change hover to `Latency — p95 (95th percentile) · 120 ms` and subtitle `based on ~8.2k calls`. Also add a small inline `p50 / p95` under headline like `32 ms / 120 ms`.

mika: overlay decision: show p95 line over heatmap on desktop but hide on mobile; add a toggle: Overlay = Auto / On / Off (default Auto). Auto = desktop on, mobile off.

raj: visual idea: when overlay is on, show dashed stroke + 1px outer glow when underlying bucket luminance conflicts. we can rely on a precomputed bucket class `bucket--dark` or `bucket--light`.

ella: accessibility: expose p50/p95 as a concise aria-live summary on range change: `Median 32 milliseconds; 95th percentile 120 milliseconds; sample size 8200`. prevents screen reader spamming.

mika: small research ask: can designOps set up 6 quick sessions for engineers and PMs to validate the ribbon and preset language? need feedback before Friday.

ux-bot: prototype snapshot: https://staging.redwood.dev/ux/1999999999  includes ribbon, presets dropdown, sampling tooltip and increased scrubber hit area. User-testing slot tentatively booked Thu 10:30.

raj: owners: ella = a11y strings + scrubber focus & keyboard help; mika = copy + research coordination; raj = visuals + palette + ribbon impl. syncing Thu 9am for a quick pass.

mika: thanks all — I'll add comments in figma tonight and push the microcopy tokens.
